_comments: HEARING THE GATEWAY THAT BILLS A SUBSCRIPTION (option E, E3 + E4 + E6). Its own dot-json so parallel work on other actions conflicts on nothing.
Orders.SyncProviderSubscriptions: the nightly backstop of the webhook. The webhook brings one subscription in line when the gateway
renews, fails, retries or ends it; this reads every gateway-billed subscription from the gateway and does the same, so a missed
webhook is caught within a day, and it is the cutover's catch-up after the import. The class holds no logic: SyncProviderSubscriptions
in CoreEntitiesServer does the work, the same function the webhook calls. Safe to ship Active: the scheduled job ships Disabled + Preview.
Orders.LinkProviderSubscription: the checked door that records that a gateway already bills an existing subscription. Linking cannot
be undone and the shared entity refuses it from any form or API; this checks the gateway subscription first, then links and syncs.

fields.Name: Sync Provider Subscriptions
fields.Description: For subscriptions a payment gateway bills (ProviderSubscriptionID set): read each one and its invoices from the gateway and bring Orders in line. Each renewal the gateway was paid for is booked as a renewal order with its payment and next term, on the subscription's own product at the amount charged; each failed collection attempt is recorded, and access is kept to the end of the gateway's next retry; a cancel-at-period-end set or withdrawn at the gateway turns automatic renewal off or on; a subscription the gateway ended is cancelled in Orders. Anything a person must decide raises one open alert Task per subscription and problem; nothing is fixed silently, and every run reports each difference it found and what it did. Preview (the default) reads both sides and writes nothing.
fields.UserPrompt: Bring gateway-billed subscriptions in line with the gateway, or preview the differences.

fields.Name: SubscriptionID
fields.Description: Sync only this subscription (an operator's targeted run). Omit for every gateway-billed subscription that is live, paused, or cancelled within the lookback.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True (the default) reads the gateway and Orders and reports every difference and what a run would do, writing nothing; false brings Orders in line. A value that is neither is refused rather than guessed.

fields.Name: Changed
fields.Description: Subscriptions brought in line (or, in a preview, that would be).

fields.Name: NeedsPerson
fields.Description: Subscriptions with nothing more to write but an open alert Task for a person.

fields.Name: Failed
fields.Description: Subscriptions the run could not read or book; the next run tries again.

fields.Name: Differences
fields.Description: Every difference found between Orders and the gateway, counted.

fields.Name: Results
fields.Description: Per subscription: the outcome, the differences found and what was done.

fields.Name: PreviewedOnly
fields.Description: True when the run was a preview and wrote nothing.

fields.Name: Link Provider Subscription
fields.Description: Record that a payment gateway already bills an existing Orders subscription, after checking the gateway subscription: it must exist and not have ended, no other Orders subscription may record it, the Orders subscription must record no gateway id yet, and the gateway customer's e-mail must be the subscriber's when both are known. Then link it and sync it, booking everything the gateway charged since the subscription's term ended. Linking cannot be undone. Preview (the default) runs every check and links nothing. Use it for an UnknownGatewaySubscription Task.
fields.UserPrompt: Link an existing subscription to the gateway subscription that already bills it.

fields.Name: SubscriptionID
fields.Description: The Orders subscription to link. It must record no gateway id yet.

fields.Name: PaymentProviderID
fields.Description: The payment provider account whose gateway bills it.

fields.Name: ProviderSubscriptionID
fields.Description: The gateway's subscription id (Stripe: sub_...). Checked at the gateway before anything is written.

fields.Name: Preview
fields.Description: True (the default) runs every check and links nothing; false links and then syncs.

fields.Name: Code
fields.Description: Linked, WouldLink, or why it was refused (SubscriptionNotFound, AlreadyLinked, ProviderCannotBill, NotAtGateway, EndedAtGateway, LinkedElsewhere, EmailMismatch, LinkFailed, BadInput).

fields.Name: Sync
fields.Description: The sync that followed the link: what was booked.
